description: The line plot, titled “Massive Activation of baseline,” illustrates the maximum activation value across 22 layers for four different components in a neural network: `attn_residual` (orange dotted line), `ffn_output` (green dash-dot line), `ffn_residual` (red solid line), and an unlabeled blue dashed line. The x-axis, labeled “Layer,” ranges from 0 to 22 with integer tick marks at every 5 units. The y-axis, labeled “Max Activation Value,” spans from 0 to 1600 with tick marks at intervals of 200. The red solid line (`ffn_residual`) remains near zero until layer 5, then sharply rises to approximately 1400, stays elevated until layer 21, and drops precipitously to about 400 at layer 22. The orange dotted line (`attn_residual`) follows a similar trajectory but with slightly lower peaks, reaching about 1550 around layer 14 before falling to 250 at layer 22. The green dash-dot line (`ffn_output`) shows a brief spike near layer 5 (to ~1300), drops to near zero, then exhibits a smaller secondary peak near layer 14 (~100), and rises again to ~1200 at layer 22. The blue dashed line remains near zero for most layers, then rises sharply to ~250 at layer 22. All lines exhibit sparse, burst-like activation patterns concentrated in early and late layers, with a quiet middle section.
